Lemma
[The Complement of a Non-Null Line is a Hyperplane]

↗ lem:orthogonal-complement

If $(V,q)$ has dimension $n$ and $x\ne 0$, then $\dim \operatorname {span}(x)^\perp =n-1$.
Proof

↗ lem:orthogonal-complement \sketch Since $\operatorname {span}(x)$ has dimension one, apply Lemma 3.

□
